playbookOutputs: Provincial Liquor Board Statutory Application Forms & Section Motivation Dossier
Formatted Provincial Gazette & Local Newspaper Public Notice Templates + SAPS DLO Inspection Checklist
playbookCommonFailures: Proposed premises is within the prohibited provincial radius (e.g. 500m) of a school or place of worship without a compelling public-interest exemption motivation
Municipal zoning certificate does not permit business/restaurant/liquor trade on the erf

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 registration certificate of the applicant entity.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID / Passports of all directors and applicant
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Premises Lease Agreement or Title Deed
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed commercial lease agreement or proof of property ownership showing right of occupation for the proposed premises.

informationToProvide.label: Municipal Zoning Certificate or Land-Use Consent
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of business/commercial zoning or special consent from the local municipality permitting liquor trade.

informationToProvide.label: Rough Floor Plan / Dimensions of Premises
informationToProvide.aiHint: Rough architectural layout or dimensioned sketch showing seating, bar area, storerooms, and emergency exits.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Tax Compliance PIN
informationToProvide.aiHint: Active SARS Tax Clearance PIN for the entity.

informationToProvide.label: SAPS Police Clearance Certificates (< 6 Months) for All Directors & Nominated Premises Manager
informationToProvide.helpText: Provincial Liquor Boards require SAPS Police Clearance Certificates (< 6 months) proving no disqualifying criminal convictions for all directors and the nominated manager.
informationToProvide.aiHint: SAPS Police Clearance Certificates issued within 180 days for all directors and the nominated liquor premises manager.

informationToProvide.label: Province, Liquor Licence Category (On-Consumption Restaurant/Tavern/Hotel vs Off-Consumption Liquor Store/Distributor), Nominated Manager Details & Proposed Trading Hours
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the province, exact type of liquor licence required, full name & ID number of the nominated on-site manager, and surrounding landmarks within 500m (schools/places of worship) for the Public Interest Motivation.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect premises details & director documentation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: ID, lease agreement, floor plan dimensions, and tax PIN verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Audit zoning status and provincial liquor act rules
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Province identified, licence category (on-consumption vs off-consumption) verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft statutory application forms, notices, and motivation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All lodgement forms and gazette notices compiled into a complete pack

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver completed pack & lodgement instructions to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Pack uploaded to client portal with step-by-step submission steps

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms quality and order closure
